name: fishball-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It is the Fishball side's library (requirements 1.40, design §1.0b row 5): it holds only modules at least two Fishball-side packages use (R-ARCH-08 strict, Fishball 2026-11-16: ui-seam, for fishball-core and fishball-ui; since the amenities split, 2026-11-21, instance-follower, for fishball-board, fishball-heartbeat and fishball-taskboard; a single-user module lives in its user), imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies. The DSH side has its own library, dsh-connector-shared; no module is shared across the sides.
description: The Fishball side's library: the fishball-core / fishball-ui seam (./ui-seam) and the amenities' fishballInstance follower (./instance-follower).
